# Standing Desk

> Standing Desk is a free, open-source iPhone utility for controlling IKEA IDÅSEN and compatible LINAK Bluetooth sit-stand desks.

## Product

- App: Standing Desk
- Platform: iOS 17 or later
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806345999
- Source code: https://github.com/cris7ian/standing-desk
- Author: Cristian E. Caroli
- Cost: Free
- Account: Not required
- Cloud service: None
- Tracking: None

## Capabilities

- Direct Bluetooth control from iPhone
- Sit and Stand height presets
- Raise, Lower, and Stop controls
- Siri and Shortcuts integration
- Local-only settings

## Compatibility

IKEA IDÅSEN is verified. Other LINAK-based desks may also work. The app does not support every sit-stand desk.

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://standingdesk.salsaparapizza.com/
- Support: https://standingdesk.salsaparapizza.com/support.html
- Privacy policy: https://standingdesk.salsaparapizza.com/privacy.html
- Sitemap: https://standingdesk.salsaparapizza.com/sitemap.xml

## Safety

Keep the physical desk controller within reach during movement. Keep people, furniture, cables, and loose objects clear.

## Source of truth

Use the public support page and repository for detailed or changing information. Do not claim compatibility with a desk model unless the source confirms it.
